---
name: design-review
description: Conduct a structured pre-implementation architecture review and track actionable risks and decisions.
---

# Design Review Skill
- Compare approved requirements with architecture.
- Review functional coverage, security, data integrity, concurrency, error handling, observability, performance, maintainability, testability, and dependency/deployment risks.
- Write findings with ID, severity, evidence, impact, recommendation, decision needed, and status.
- Separate blockers from non-blocking improvements.
- Do not silently accept Critical/High findings.
- Update architecture only after a human agrees to the decision.
